subject: engineering
intro: Engineering leads into the licensed professions that design, build and safeguard the physical world: mechanical, electrical, materials, safety and industrial engineers all start from this breadth of fundamentals.

roles.title: Mechanical Engineers
roles.what: Perform engineering duties in planning and designing tools, engines, machines and other mechanically functioning equipment, and oversee the installation, operation, maintenance and repair of centralised heat, gas, water and steam systems.
roles.where: Statics, dynamics, strength of materials and thermodynamics and heat transfer are the mechanical engineer's core; the mathematics and fluid mechanics units supply the modelling every design calculation rests on.

roles.title: Electrical Engineers
roles.what: Research, design, develop, test or supervise the manufacturing and installation of electrical equipment, components or systems for commercial, industrial, military or scientific use.
roles.where: The basic electrical engineering unit — charge and current, Kirchhoff and Ohm's laws, AC and DC circuits, three-phase power — is this syllabus in miniature; instrumentation and controls adds the sensors and signal processing those systems need.

roles.title: Materials Engineers
roles.what: Evaluate materials and develop machinery and processes to manufacture materials that meet specialised design and performance specifications — working with metals, ceramics, glass, plastics, polymers and composites.
roles.where: The materials unit's phase diagrams and mechanical, chemical, thermal and electrical properties map directly onto the role; oxidation and corrosion from the chemistry unit is a daily failure mode to design against.

roles.title: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
roles.what: Promote worksite or product safety by applying knowledge of industrial processes, mechanics, chemistry, psychology and industrial health and safety laws, including industrial product safety engineering.
roles.where: The safety, health and environment unit — industrial hygiene, protective equipment, gas detection, electrical safety, hazard communication — plus the ethics unit's public-protection strand is the job description.

roles.title: Industrial Engineers
roles.what: Design, develop, test and evaluate integrated systems for managing industrial production, including human work factors, quality control, inventory control, logistics and material flow, cost analysis and production coordination.
roles.where: Engineering economics — time value of money, break-even analysis, project selection — and the probability and statistics unit's estimation and hypothesis testing are the analyst tools industrial engineers run systems with.
